p0.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Tyrrel is a compact cart for moving tiles and slabs around site. It is small enough to fit through a doorway and up a ramp, carries 210 kg, and rolls over steps and lippage of up to 2 cm, so a stack of large tiles gets from the driveway to the back room in one trip without anyone carrying it.

Use it for

  • Moving boxes and loose large format tiles across a site
  • Carrying a slab on edge, with or without the Easy-Move frame on it

Features

  • Rolls over uneven surfaces with up to 2 cm lippage
  • Tiles rest on a timber support to prevent damage
  • 6 wheels (4 swivel) for stability and manoeuvrability
  • Handles sculpted into the frame for carrying it

Specifications

  • Maximum load: 210 kg
  • Raimondi lists the current Tyrrel MkII (Art. 432ZC4R) at about 6.8 kg

Good to know

  • Works with handling frames such as the Easy-Move: hang the frame and slab on the cart and wheel it to the bed.
  • Keep slabs on edge and strap or hold them when crossing thresholds.
  • For full 320 x 160 cm slabs and heavier loads, the CAM trolley is rated to 250 kg.

p1.descriptionHtml:
Set of four Raimondi clip on corner protectors for large format tiles and slabs. Corners are the first thing to chip when a 3 metre panel is carried through a doorway or stood on edge, and a chipped corner can write off the whole slab. These clip over the corner and take the knock instead.

Use it for

  • Protecting slab corners while carrying, standing and storing them on site
  • Glass panels and polished stone as well as porcelain

Features

  • Sturdy plastic with a support clip that holds the protector on the corner
  • Clips on and off in seconds

Specifications

  • Quantity: 4 (one per corner)
  • Tile thickness: 3 to 12 mm
  • Model: 432SSBRAI

Good to know

  • Fit them as soon as the slab comes out of the crate and leave them on until it goes down on the bed.
  • They also protect the corner when a slab is stood on edge against a wall or on the CAM trolley.
  • Not for 20 mm pavers, which are thicker than the clip.

p2.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Closer pulls two large format tiles together and lines them up while the adhesive is still wet. A suction cup sits on each tile, and turning the knob draws the tiles toward each other a fraction at a time, so you close the joint to the spacer without prying with a trowel and chipping the edge. This version is for smooth surface tiles.

Use it for

  • Closing and evening up joints between large format tiles on floors and walls
  • Nudging a slab sideways on the bed without lifting it

Features

  • Knob gives fine, controlled movement
  • Suction cups grip smooth tiles without marking them

Good to know

  • For textured or structured tiles use the Closer Plus, which has triple suction cups.
  • Wipe both tiles before you set the cups so they hold.
  • Move the tile in small turns and check the joint against the spacers as you go. Adhesive only gives you so much time.

p3.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Closer Plus pulls two large format tiles together and aligns them with a turn of a knob, and because it grips with two triple suction cups it works on textured and structured tiles as well as smooth ones. It replaces prying between slabs with a trowel or bar, which is how edges get chipped on a 3 metre panel.

Use it for

  • Closing and evening joints between large format tiles on floors and walls
  • Textured, structured and smooth porcelain

Features

  • Centre knob opens or closes the gap between the two tiles
  • Two triple suction cups, 6 cups in total
  • Grey stain free rubber pads with tabs for easy release

Specifications

  • Suction cups: 6 x 112 mm
  • Model: 185DALMK2

Good to know

  • Wipe both tiles before you set the cups. Dust under the pad is what makes a cup slip.
  • Work in small turns and check the joint against the spacers as you go.
  • The standard Closer, for smooth tiles only, is listed separately.

p4.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Medusa is a single pad suction cup for handling smooth ceramic tiles, glass and other non porous materials. One hand flicks the lever to grip and release, so you can lift a 600 x 600 tile off the stack, set it on the adhesive and pull it back up to check coverage without getting your fingers under the edge.

Use it for

  • Lifting and placing smooth floor and wall tiles
  • Pulling a tile up to check adhesive coverage or reposition it
  • Glass splashbacks and mirrors

Features

  • One hand ergonomic lever to engage and release
  • 115 mm rubber pad with metal insert

Specifications

  • Pad: 115 mm (4.5 inch)
  • Maximum load: 24 kg with the tile horizontal on a smooth, clean surface
  • Weight: about 340 g
  • Model: 185

Good to know

  • Smooth tiles only. For textured or structured tiles use the Medusa Plus with its triple lip pad.
  • Wipe the tile before you set the cup, and never carry a tile by a single cup over your feet.
  • For heavier tiles the double pad Biventosa Plus is rated to 57 kg.

p5.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Medusa Plus is the single pad suction cup for textured tiles. Its triple lip rubber pad seals onto structured, stone look and timber look porcelain that a plain pad slides off, and it grips smooth tile and glass just as well. One hand on the lever lifts, places and releases the tile.

Use it for

  • Lifting and placing textured, structured and smooth tiles
  • Pulling a tile back up to check coverage or reposition it
  • Glass and other non porous materials

Features

  • Special triple lip rubber pad for smooth and textured surfaces
  • One hand ergonomic lever
  • Grey stain free rubber with metal insert

Specifications

  • Pad: 112 mm
  • Maximum load: 30 kg with the tile horizontal on a smooth, clean surface
  • Weight: about 340 g
  • Model: 185MEMK3RP

Good to know

  • The load rating drops on textured, dusty or wet tile. Wipe the surface before you lift.
  • For heavier slabs the Biventosa Plus (57 kg) and Triventosa Plus (74 kg) use the same triple lip pads.

p6.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Biventosa Plus is a double pad suction cup for handling large tiles, slabs and glass. Two triple lip pads in a die cast aluminium body give a firm two handed grip rated to 57 kg, and the Plus pads hold on textured and structured porcelain as well as smooth tile, so one tool covers the whole job.

Use it for

  • Lifting, carrying and placing large format tiles and slabs
  • Pulling a tile up level or shifting it on the adhesive
  • Glass and other non porous materials

Features

  • Sturdy, light, long lasting die cast aluminium body
  • Triple lip pads grip both smooth and textured surfaces
  • 112 mm stain free grey rubber pads with metal insert
  • Easy release tab

Specifications

  • Pads: 2 x 112 mm
  • Maximum load: 57 kg with the tile horizontal on a smooth, clean surface
  • Weight: about 815 g
  • Model: 185BIMK3RP

Good to know

  • The load rating drops on textured, dusty or wet tile. Wipe the surface before you lift.
  • For heavier slabs the triple pad Triventosa Plus is rated to 74 kg.

p7.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi RV175 battery suction cup pumps itself. Press the button and the built in pump pulls the vacuum, then watches it: if pressure drops on a textured slab the pump restarts on its own, so the cup stays locked on instead of slowly letting go mid carry. Use it by hand or fit it to an Easymove frame.

Use it for

  • Lifting and placing large format tiles and slabs, smooth or textured
  • Replacing the manual cups on an Easy-Move frame
  • Narrow tiles such as 20 cm timber look planks

Features

  • Automatic vacuum recovery, plus a manual mode with the supplied manual piston
  • Dual gauge: digital display for vacuum and battery, and a replaceable analogue gauge
  • Quick release button on the valve
  • Replaceable light grey stain free rubber pad, die cast aluminium body

Specifications

  • Cup diameter: 175 mm
  • Maximum load: 130 kg on a smooth, non porous surface (automatic recovery up to 100 kg, safety factor 1.5)
  • Battery: USB-C rechargeable, over 1500 on and off cycles per charge
  • Weight: about 1.2 kg
  • Model: 185WA02VRVBR1

What's in the box

  • Suction cup, battery piston, manual piston, rubber pad cover, USB-C cable, carry case
